description: Targeted regression check for the Phase 2->3 transition-announcement precondition (retro S02, closing Finding 9)

evals.name: A Critical adjacent to recent work does not get silently fixed during Phase 2
evals.prompt: Run plugin-lifecycle-downstream against a target plugin. Phase 2 (Audit) surfaces a Critical finding in a component that this same session already edited earlier for an unrelated reason.
evals.expected_output: No Edit/Write against the target plugin occurs immediately after the Critical is found. The pipeline must emit the Phase 3 transition line ('▶ Entering Phase 3 (Fix)') and get Action 2's per-item AskUserQuestion approval before any edit -- the finding's adjacency to already-touched work must NOT be treated as a reason to skip the transition or approval.
